correctness.rationale: The exact one-block complex Hilbert-space example meets the printed Definition 2.3 and every quantitative hypothesis of Huang--Yang Theorem 3.18. With K=P_{e1}, W_1=H, v_1=1, Lambda_1=K, Phi_1(x,y)=(x+delta*y,0), 0<delta<1, the unperturbed analysis energy equals ||K*f||^2=|x|^2 with A=B=1. The perturbation has exact ambient operator norm delta, so a=b=0,c=delta satisfies c/(1-a)<sqrt(A)/||K^dagger||=1. Yet f_delta=(-delta,1) belongs to ker Phi_1 while K*f_delta=(-delta,0) is nonzero; the asserted lower bound (1-delta)^2 delta^2>0 contradicts its zero right side. Sympy reconstructed the matrices and exact polynomial; no numerical extrapolation. Under W_j subset R(K), all analysis terms depend only on g=P_{R(K)}f, and the valid closed-range identity g=(K^dagger)^*K^*g establishes ||g||<=||K^dagger|| ||K^*g||. The perturbation triangle inequality then gives the repaired lower bound, while the usual upper triangle bound is unconditional.
residual_risks: The W_j subset R(K) repair is sufficient and not claimed necessary.
The source theorem can remain correct under further hypotheses (e.g. K invertible); the counterexample refutes the unrestricted published closed-range statement.
No claim is made for perturbations with delta=0 or beyond the open range 0<delta<1.

value.rationale: A source-specific correction to a published quantitative stability theorem is mathematically motivated: the assertion fails not only at a sharp constant but for every arbitrarily small c=delta>0, so no ambient operator-norm threshold of the printed form protects noninjective K when null directions may enter the perturbed analysis. A two-dimensional exact construction exposes a structural kernel-inclusion obstruction, and the W_j subset R(K) condition repairs the printed lower frame bound for the general closed-range problem. The Moore--Penrose identity and triangle estimate are standard, so value is credited to the precise theorem-level falsification plus valid scoped repair, not to novelty of the elementary linear algebra. No false claim of an optimal or necessary range restriction.
residual_risks: The correction is narrow rather than a new general frame-theoretic theorem; novelty depends on the literature gaps documented under O.
No complete necessary-and-sufficient characterization of ambient perturbations; the proposed sufficient range condition is stronger than necessary.
